title: lovellm: Reference Implementation of the Artificial Partiality (Love) Mechanism
description: Reference implementation accompanying the paper 'Love for Believable AI: Artificial Partiality and Relationship Persistence as an Engineerable Stance'. Includes the lovellm mechanism, constructed-persona generator, seven evaluation arms, synthetic and open-weight-model runners, analytical prediction files with SHA-256 integrity checks, stored result tables, selected per-run decision inputs, a versioned analysis record, and tests. The open-weight model is mlx-community/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-4bit at revision a5339a4131f135d0fdc6a5c8b5bbed2753bbe0f3. Raw generated text from the historical real-model runs was not retained. Protocol amendments and their outputs were committed together, so the repository does not establish independent temporal precedence and is not described as a preregistration. All relationships are constructed personas; the artifact contains no human data.
